author: Forbes
description:
Everyone seems to be rushing into AI programs, hoping another degree will future-proof their
career. But what if that's the wrong strategy?
In this episode of Work Hotline, Sho Dewan breaks down the surprising data behind today's
graduate job market and explains why more education doesn't automatically lead to more
opportunities.
From the explosion of AI master's programs to rising unemployment among younger master's
degree holders, this episode explores what hiring managers are actually looking for—and why
proof of work often beats another credential.
This isn't an argument against higher education. It's an argument against making expensive
career decisions out of fear.
Before you spend thousands on another degree, ask yourself one question: Are you running
toward your future—or running away from uncertainty?
